:::{#thm-rrd-vs-rr}
#### Relative risk difference equals risk ratio minus 1

$$\xi(\pi_1,\pi_2) = \rho(\pi_1,\pi_2) - 1$$
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof
$$
\begin{aligned}
\xi(\pi_1,\pi_2)
&\eqdef \frac{\delta(\pi_1,\pi_2)}{\pi_2}
\\&= \frac{\pi_1-\pi_2}{\pi_2}
\\&= \frac{\pi_1}{\pi_2} - 1
\\&= \rho(\pi_1,\pi_2) - 1
\end{aligned}
$$
:::
